opening.argument: The video pairs a BitConnect giveaway with an explicit request to receive BCC “so I can start lending.” That connection ties the reward-oriented offer directly to cryptocurrency participation. The lending and reinvestment panel then describes daily profit depending on the investment option and receiving capital back after the investment term, presenting lending through the prospect of returns. Together, these features establish the scam character of the offer. The limitation is clear: the sampled wallet view displays zero investment and earnings totals and no recorded transactions, so it does not establish actual payouts or losses.
